event:
I withdrew the finding. Other spec text answers most of what it asks, and the verdict was accepted.

- **Which LOCK:** the lock register's description in `src/mci/rtl/mci_reg.rdl:830-831` says each bit locks the associated `VALID_AXI_USER` register. So the referent is `MBOX1_AXI_USER_LOCK[n]`, paired one-to-one with `MBOX1_VALID_AXI_USER[n]`.
- **What "valid" means:** the integration spec (`docs/CaliptraSSIntegrationSpecification.md:2293-2296`) says trusted users must be configured through these lockable registers "before MBOX can be used by SOC agents". An entry counts as a trusted user only once it is configured and locked.
- **Who can access:** the hardware spec (`docs/CaliptraSSHardwareSpecification.md:1297-1299`) says only the trusted users, the default user 0xFFFF_FFFF and MCU can access the mailbox. Any other user gets an AXI error response.

No spec text says outright that an unlocked entry is ignored. I inferred that from "only valid once locked" and the integration spec's "before MBOX can be used". I judged that clear enough for a test writer, so I withdrew rather than marking it inconclusive. A sentence in the hardware spec stating the unlocked behaviour would remove the remaining doubt. I did not check the RTL.

I did not modify any files.
